title: Engineering Manager
description:
We have real traction and proven scale, and we're now setting up how engineering works for our next wave of European growth. You would lead one of the teams doing it, and shape the practices the others follow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You would lead one of our product engineering teams: what it ships, how it runs, and how the people in it grow. Product and engineering together are ~25 people, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

It's a hands-on role. One week you're in a design review, the next - in a few Claude-enabled contributions, the next - in performance conversations, and most weeks - all of that combined. You should love zooming in and out, from feedback on an API spec to a quarter's priorities. Your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it.

Beyond your team, you would shape how engineering works at Insify together with the other Engineering Managers, a Staff Engineer and the VP Engineering: architecture, product discovery, how engineers grow.


What you'll be doing
  • Leading a team of product engineers end to end: what you ship, how it performs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
  • Bringing architecture and product thinking into the team's daily work, so that new product demands turn into platform capabilities that scale across countries and insurance products, rather than one-off builds
  • Running product discovery with your team: working with the Insurance, Operations and Growth teams on what to build, and saying no when the answer is no
  • Shaping company-wide engineering practices alongside the other Engineering Managers: ways of working, architecture & technology practices, the growth framework
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

  • A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've run or driven product discovery, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed

title: Head of Event Marketing
description:
About CodeRabbit

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship.

We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge.

CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion.

Location: Remote USA

Role Overview

At CodeRabbit, we seek an exceptional and passionate Head of Event Marketing to build and lead our global events program. With more than 20,000 customers and a place on the AI 50, CodeRabbit is one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world, and events are one of our most important engines for brand, pipeline and direct revenue. You will own a truly global remit spanning North America, Western Europe, Japan and the broader APAC region, with a multi-million dollar budget that is growing year over year.

This is a builder role. You will inherit a strong core team, grow it, and set the strategy for every event we sponsor or host, from Tier 1 conferences like AWS re:Invent, Google Cloud Next and NVIDIA GTC, to local-market engineering leadership events, to our own customer conferences across multiple continents. We don't just show up and staff a booth. We want a strategic, creative and analytical leader who designs the full experience around each event and can generate return on every dollar invested.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, hire and develop a global events team

  • Own the global events strategy and budget, making investment decisions grounded in ROI across brand, pipeline and direct revenue

  • Lead our presence at sponsored events and engineering events

  • Build and scale CodeRabbit's own hosted events

  • Determine the right event mix for each territory

title: Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Join SE3 Labs as Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer

Join our new Software Platform team and make the devices, networks and compute behind SE3's autonomy run reliably, so our engineers can focus on what they do best.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Software Platform team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer, you'll be a founding member of our new Software Platform team and own everything infrastructure apart from cybersecurity: software distribution to our platforms, device provisioning, networks, our compute cluster and CI. You'll work on-site in Munich alongside our cybersecurity engineer and the CV, robotics and firmware teams, with occasional visits to our second site.

What You'll Work On

  • Over-the-Air Updates: Unify our separate update and software distribution setups for Jetson, NXP and other edge nodes into one reliable system for every platform.

  • Device Provisioning: Provision, configure and maintain Linux-based edge devices, workstations and ground systems, including ARM64 platforms.

  • Deployment Automation: Build reproducible container images, deployments, device configuration, release workflows and recovery procedures, with Bash and Python tooling.

  • Networks & Remote Access: Design and troubleshoot connectivity across networked and remote devices, including routing, SSH, VPNs, firewalls and constrained field links.

  • Compute Cluster & CI: Make our GPU compute and evaluation cluster and self-hosted CI runners reliable, so engineers can depend on them without manual recovery.

  • Monitoring & Documentation: Improve monitoring, service availability

description:
Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're scaling rapidly and need a skilled Mobile Service Engineer to look after our growing estate from Manchester southwards.

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on and proactive Mobile Service Engineer to manage the maintenance and overall health of our car park infrastructure from Manchester southwards, ensuring that downtime on sites due to equipment failure is kept to a minimum. You'll be responsible for the ongoing maintenance of existing sites and the coordination of subcontractors to keep operations running seamlessly. The role calls for a mix of technical expertise, knowledge of CCTV/ANPR cameras and a problem-solving mindset, with regular site visits to either oversee or carry out maintenance work.

Location & Travel

This is a field-based role covering our southern estate, from Manchester southwards and down to the South West, including St Austell in Cornwall. The ideal candidate will be based within this area and must be able to travel regularly to sites across all of our southern locations. We also have a North equivalent of this role, so there may be the odd occasion where you're asked to cover sites further north. We're flexible on working hours where long journeys are involved, and travel time will be factored in where necessary.

Key Responsibilities

  • Equipment maintenance: Maintain ANPR cameras, Pay & Display machines, tablets, signage and other related equipment.

  • RAMS: Ensure Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) are prepared and followed when on site.

  • Signage & frontline maintenance: Install and replace signage and kiosk consumables as required, ensuring compliance with safety and operational standards.

  • Issue resolution: Diagnose and resolve technical issues on site, ensuring all equipment functions optimally.

  • Compliance & safety: Adhere to all safe working procedures and compliance guidelines, ensuring a safe and effective work environment.

  • Site visits: Visit sites from Manchester southwards on a scheduled basis to carry out general site health checks.

title: Privacy & Product Counsel
description:
This role can be office-based in Freiburg, Germany/ San Francisco, USA or remote-first, with a requirement to be in the office one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.


Why This Role

Every FLUX release, API feature and enterprise offering requires legal oversight. Black Forest Labs’ (BFL) frontier technologies raise questions where there is no established precedent – especially as we push further into video, perception and physical AI.

We’re hiring a Privacy & Product Counsel to find solutions and help drive our product teams forward. You’ll sit in our Legal, Policy & Assurance (LPA) team and be embedded with research, product and engineering, shaping how BFL builds and ships.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build a privacy function at the frontier of AI and robotics.

What You’ll Work On

  • Product counselling. Be the go-to lawyer for product teams on new models, API features and innovative products, from first spec to launch, giving clear, risk-calibrated advice that keeps us shipping.

  • Marketing. Partner with our Growth, Marketing and DevRel teams to review launch announcements, model cards and campaign copy so that our claims about FLUX are accurate. Advise on privacy matters relating to product marketing, analytics, commercial and creator partnerships, and advertising claims.

  • Privacy by design. Own BFL’s GDPR programme across the model lifecycle: training data, fine-tuning, inference, logging and retention. Run point on DPIAs and privacy documentation as required.

  • Customer commitments. Partner with GTM on DPAs, zero-data-retention and no-training terms, security questionnaires and enterprise negotiations – and work with the team to ensure that what we promise matches what we do.

  • International

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Für Deutschlands größtes unabhängiges Homecare-Unternehmen aus Ahrensburg bei Hamburg suche ich einen Salesforce Developer, der die Plattform-Entwicklung nach innen holt. Salesforce ist dort der operative Steuerungspunkt für Vertrieb und Service, angebunden an SAP und weitere Kernsysteme. Der Code entsteht heute überwiegend bei externen Entwicklern. Genau das änderst du: Als interner Salesforce Developer wirst du zum Maschinenraum der Plattform und baust das Know-how auf, das bisher eingekauft wurde.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Apex & LWC: Du entwickelst eigenständig in Apex und Lightning Web Components und testest, deployst und dokumentierst deine Lösungen selbst.

  • Schnittstellen & KI: Du bereitest Salesforce für APIs und KI-Anwendungen vor, etwa für Integrationen oder einen geplanten Telefon-Bot im Kundenservice.

  • Architektur & Reviews: Du arbeitest an Solution Designs mit, führst Code-, Design- und Architektur-Reviews durch und etablierst Best Practices im Team.

  • Know-how nach innen: Du arbeitest eng mit der Teamleitung und externen Entwicklern zusammen und holst die Projektarbeit Schritt für Schritt nach innen.

Dein Profil

  • Salesforce-Entwicklung: Du bringst rund drei Jahre intensive Erfahrung in Apex, LWC und komplexen Flows inklusive APIs mit und erklärst die Komplexität an eigenen Projekten.

  • DevOps & Release: Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im DevOps- und Release-Management mit, vor allem im Pipeline-Management, und hast erste Kenntnisse in Security & Sharing.

  • ITSM-Verständnis: Du kennst Incident-, Problem- und Change-Management und lässt ein Projekt auch mal liegen, wenn ein Major Incident das Business blockiert. Eine ITIL-Zertifizierung brauchst du nicht.

  • Teamplayer: Du arbeitest pragmatisch mit Kollegen und externen Partnern und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch, der Arbeitssprache im Team. Zertifizierungen wie Platform Developer sind ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung.

Das erwartet dich

  • Plattform statt Projekt: eine neu geschaffene Rolle mit viel Eigenverantwortung, Mitsprache bei Architektur und Projekten vom Telefon-Bot bis zur KI-Roadmap.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine flexible Remote-Regelung (2-3 Tage die Woche; individuelle Regelungen sind denkbar)

  • Dazu Hardware nach Wahl bis hin zum Mac und KI-Coding-Tools im Rahmen der europäischen Datenvorgaben.

  • Team mit Humor: ein harmonisches Team, das sich trotz vollem Kalender Zeit füreinander nimmt, bis zur gemeinsamen Mittagspause im Büro.

  • Konditionen & Benefits: ein faires Vergütungspaket in unbefristeter Festanstellung, dazu 30 Tage Urlaub, betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss, Urban Sports, Business Bike Leasing, Corporate Benefits und der hauseigene Weiterbildungs-Campus.

title: Senior Software Engineer
Customer Success Manager
description:
Elliptic has been tracking down crypto crime since 2013, trusted by banks, businesses, and governments worldwide to keep the financial system safe. Today, our compliance tools cover the large majority of global crypto exchange volume, and a $120m Series D is fueling the next stage of that work.

You’ll own a portfolio of 40-50 crypto businesses, fintechs, banks and stablecoin issuers that rely on Elliptic for their compliance programmes, making sure each one sees measurable value, renews with confidence and grows with us. Existing customers now get as much attention as new ones, so this is a chance to help shape the Customer Success function as it comes into its own.

What you’ll bring

  • B2B customer success or account management experience in SaaS, ideally with a mid-market book, and numbers to show for owned renewals or expansion (NRR, GRR, ARR)

  • A financial services background: crypto, regtech, payments or traditional finance

  • A structured, organised approach to client meetings, and the maturity to be trusted by clients and offer a view

  • A close eye on the commercials, even when a renewal isn’t yours alone

  • Fluency with AI tools as part of your daily workflow, you use them to move faster and think better, and you know when not to trust them

Bonus points for AML, KYC or financial crime compliance experience, familiarity with blockchain, Web3 or digital assets, a second European language, or an interest in representing Elliptic at industry events.

What you’ll do

  • Own the health, retention and expansion pipeline across your portfolio, using health scores and usage data to decide where to spend your time

  • Run renewals end to end, forecasting risk accurately and negotiating commercial terms

  • Spot and lead expansion opportunities, closing them yourself or bringing in the aligned Account Executive

  • Run QBRs that show the value customers get from Elliptic, bring in Solutions and Product where needed, and help shape the EMEA team’s playbooks, tools and processes

What we offer you

  • Hybrid working: work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days a year

  • Home off

title: Strategy & Operations Director
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

title: Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™, EMEA
Senior Sales Engineer, France
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

Horizon3 is committed to defending businesses from the ever-growing threat landscape. Our advanced solutions and expert team provide unparalleled security for our clients. We are looking for a passionate Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect to join our team and help prospects and clients understand the true value and capabilities of our products and services.

  • Technical expertise - Demonstrate deep knowledge of our cybersecurity products and services, assisting the sales team in presenting and position them to prospects and clients

  • Customer engagement - Meet with potential customers to understand their cybersecurity needs, challenges, and infrastructure, ensuring that our solutions are the perfect fit for them

  • Product demonstrations - Provide live demos and proof of concepts for our cybersecurity solutions, tailoring each demo to the specific needs and concerns of the potential customer

  • Solution development - Will work closely with the sales and product teams to design and refine our solutions based on customer needs

  • Technical training - train the sales team on the technical aspects of our products to enhance their ability to sell more effectively

  • Feedback loop - relay feedback from the field to our product and engineering teams, contributing to the ongoing improvement of our product

Haste mirrors the complexity of high-stakes compute infrastructure—HPC supercomputers, trillion-parameter AI workloads, quantum computers, and enterprise infrastructure—letting security teams detect, hunt, and analyze only relevant threats lightning fast.

title: Payroll Specialist
description:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

 

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

 

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

 

About the Role

 

We're hiring a Payroll Specialist to join Sona's payroll bureau, taking hands-on ownership of UK payroll processing for a portfolio of our customers.

Our bureau is growing fast. We're moving from around 15,000 payslips a month to roughly 22,000 by the start of Q4, driven by new customer go-lives in hospitality and care. That means the pace of the role is genuinely high, and we're hiring ahead of that curve rather than catching up after the fact.

Day to day, you'll manage a portfolio of standard and mid-complexity clients across multiple pay frequencies: statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC filings and payroll journal reconciliation. You'll also handle client queries through our support desk, working to fast turnaround times. Your work is checked by a Senior Payroll Specialist before it reaches clients, as part of our standard quality process.

This isn't a conventional bureau role. Sona is a startup and the payroll team is still building its own processes and tools, so there's genuine room to shape how things work and to grow as the bureau scales. You'll be working on a product in a sector most software has ignored, and once you're through probation we support CIPP study through the apprenticeship levy.

Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.

Saviynt is looking for a professional, highly motivated, and energetic Strategic Account Executive  to drive regional sales for our disruptive IaaS Cloud Security, Access Governance & Privileged Access Mgmt. (PAM) solutions. The Strategic Account Executive will combine a good working knowledge of (IaaS & SaaS) Identity, Cloud Security, or PAM with prospecting and sales skills. You will ultimately be responsible for the entire enterprise sales cycle and meeting or exceeding territory quota. Strategic Account Executives are the primary interface to both Prospects and Customers and are responsible for actively driving and managing day-to-day prospecting and selling activity in the region. This activity includes opportunity Discovery, Demo, RFP/RFI, Evaluation & POC stages of the sales process, and working in conjunction with Sales Engineering & Product Management Teams to identify and close new deals.  This job is located remotely in Germany.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING
  • Effectively interact with Field Sales, Cloud Team, and Line of Business decision makers.
  • Learn and maintain knowledge of Saviynt’s solutions, focused on Cloud.
  • Security, Cloud Access Governance and PAM
  • Aggressively identify qualified sales opportunities across all assigned accounts.
  • Develop and leverage all lead sources (personal and partner contacts, inbound leads, events, and outbound prospecting) to generate a meaningful pipeline.
  • Maintain disciplined, detailed, and up-to-date records on Lead and opportunity activity in SFDC to ensure effective leadership development, proper team communication, and executive visibility.
  • Be diligent in timely follow-up and provide quality work products.
  • Attend and assist with corporate and field sales and marketing events.
  • Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue objectives.

    • WHAT YOU BRING
  • 7+ years sales experience in enterprise Identity, Cloud Security, or PAM Sales preferred

title: Software Engineer Intern, Trading
description:
Talos: Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Whether in-office or remote, you’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Software Engineer Intern, Trading

Talos is seeking a Software Engineering Intern to join our Trading team for the Summer 2027. This intern will work on a critical project related to our high-performance trading systems, contributing to tools that support trading decision-making and performance evaluation. Success in this role will involve designing and building components that enhance our algorithmic capabilities while adding new features to existing infrastructure.

Want to learn more about Talos’s engineering culture? Check out Sonic, our first open-source project which allows Talos to achieve microsecond network stack latency in Go: https://github.com/talostrading/sonic

title: Account Executive - EMEA Specialist
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment.  As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product.  AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment.   Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you're meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you're diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.

title: Sales Development Representative - LATAM
description:
About You

As Constructor.io’s Sales Development Representative (SDR), you’ll be crucial to driving lead generation activities for Constructor. You’ll be expected to become intimately familiar with Constructor’s product offering and key differentiators in the search space. You’re looking to contribute in an entrepreneurial environment and will enjoy access to the founders and leaders in other functional groups.

You love technology, understand Software as a Service, and are excited to take a key role in contributing to the success of a fast-growing startup. You are an excellent communicator and enjoy getting to know customers out of genuine interest and concern for their needs.

You’ll work with our outbound automation system to find leads, send emails, use Linkedin Sales Navigator, generate interest, and schedule sales calls. As the point of first contact in our sales process, you’ll be the face of Constructor to new business opportunities. You’ll qualify leads, gather as much information about the prospect as you can, and work with our sales team to close the sale. If you’re awesome, you’ll grow into an Account Executive position by taking on progressively more account responsibilities.

 

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

title: FMEA Moderator/ Consutant (m/w/d) - VDA & mehr
description:
QMH Consulting unterstützt Unternehmen aus Automotive, MedTech, Maschinenbau und Elektronik dabei, FMEA normkonform, auditfest und praxistauglich in ihre Prozesse zu integrieren.

Dafür suchen wir eine/-n FMEA-Moderator / Consultant (m/w/d), der/die Projekte methodensicher führt, Teams strukturiert durch die 7 Schritte leitet und Ergebnisse schafft, die Audits bestehen und im Alltag wirken.

Aufgaben

Aufgaben

  • Moderation von Design- und Prozess-FMEA nach AIAG/VDA in Entwicklungs- und Serienprojekten

  • Strukturierung und Durchführung der 7 Schritte inkl. Funktions-, Fehler-, Risiko- und Maßnahmenanalyse

  • Dokumentation in APIS, PLATO oder kundenspezifischen Tools; Pflege von Struktur- und Netzansichten

  • FMEA-Reviews: Plausibilitäts-, Vollständigkeits- und Wirksamkeitschecks; Ableitung von Verbesserungen

  • FMEA-Prozessaufbau: Rollen, Templates, Timings, Schnittstellen (APQP, Control Plan, SPC)

  • Training & Coaching von Fachabteilungen bis zur Moderatorenqualifikation

  • Vorbereitung auf Kunden-/Auditorenanforderungen (z. B. VDA 6.3) und Unterstützung bei Freigaben

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung, Qualität, Produktion, Lieferanten und Projektleitung

Qualifikation

Qualifikation

  • Technisches Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation (z. B. Techniker:in/Meister:in)

  • Praxis in FMEA-Moderation (D-/P-FMEA) nach AIAG/VDA – idealerweise in Automotive oder regulierten Branchen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit APIS oder PLATO (alternativ schnelle Auffassungsgabe für neue Tools)

  • Erfahrung in Prozess-/Produktentwicklung, Qualität oder Produktion

  • Methodensicherheit, klare Kommunikation und stringente Moderation heterogener Teams

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Reisebereitschaft für Workshops beim Kunden (nach Bedarf)

Benefits

Benefits

  • Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung und attraktive Zusatzleistungen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 100 % Remote möglich, klare Prozesse

  • Unbefristeter Vertrag und strukturierte Einarbeitung

  • Projekte mit Substanz bei OEMs, Tier-1 und Mittelstand

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Prozessaufbau, Templates, Guidelines, Tool-Einführung

  • Kollegiales Team, flache Hierarchien und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.

You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

title: Senior Solution Architect (m/w/d)
description:
Unser Kunde ist ein international tätiges Medizintechnikunternehmen mit Sitz in Deutschland. Als Senior Solution Architect (m/w/d) verantworten Sie die Konzeption und Integration komplexer IT-Lösungen und agieren als technische Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Vertrieb, Engineering und Produktmanagement.

Die Position ist Hybrid oder Remote möglich.


Ihre Aufgaben in dieser Rolle:

  • Konzeption und Gestaltung skalierbarer Enterprise-Architekturen für Lösungen im Gesundheitswesen

  • Leitung von Integrationsprojekten über klinische Systeme, Cloud-Plattformen und unternehmensweite Anwendungen hinweg

  • Sicherstellung der Interoperabilität durch die Integration klinischer Informationssysteme, medizinischer Anwendungen und unternehmensweiter IT-Systeme

  • Unterstützung bei der Implementierung sicherer Hybrid-Cloud- und On Premise-Lösungen

  • Entwicklung von Infrastruktur-, Konnektivitäts-, Cybersecurity- und Implementierungskonzepten

  • Durchführung von Kundenworkshops, technischen Anforderungsanalysen und Architekturprüfungen

  • Unterstützung des Vertriebs durch technische Beratung, Bewertung technischer Risiken und Positionierung geeigneter Lösungskonzepte

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen, funktionsübergreifenden Teams zur Sicherstellung einer erfolgreichen Implementierung der Lösungen

Das bringen Sie für die Position mit:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Lösungsarchitektur, Softwarearchitektur oder im Bereich Healthcare-IT

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englisch- Kenntnisse

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Integration von Enterprise-Systemen und verteilten IT-Systemen

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen wie AWS, Azure oder vergleichbaren Lösungen

Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Infrastructure to own and scale the infrastructure foundation behind this platform.

This is a unique opportunity to lead an infrastructure organization combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while building the operational maturity required to support 2x growth.

You will report directly to Sergei, our CTO, and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

Why this role is different

Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes.

Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs.

You will work across:

  • Telecom infrastructure — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally.
  • On-premise infrastructure — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams.
  • Cloud infrastructure — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments.
  • Stateful systems — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads.
  • Distributed systems — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads.

title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations - Remote
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.

Who we are ?

Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.

The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise.

The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes.

A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. Warum Oviva?

In der Schweiz beschäftigen wir rund 150 Mitarbeitende, darunter Psychotherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Ärztinnen und Ärzte. Gemeinsam bieten wir eine integrierte Behandlung für Menschen mit Adipositas und anderen metabolischen Erkrankungen an, die Ernährung, Bewegung, Psychotherapie und, wo medizinisch sinnvoll, medikamentöse Therapie verbindet. Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang. Unsere Patientinnen sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patientinnen mit gewichts- und ernährungsbedingten Grundproblemen benötigen Unterstützung bei diversen psychischen und neurodivergenten Herausforderungen, wie etwa ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depressionen oder Angststörungen. title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelin

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar bzw. eine vergleichbare Ausbildung.

  • Kenntnisse in SAP Fiori und SAP UI5.

  • Kenntnisse der SAP Business Technology Platform sowie Erfahrung mit Schnittstellentechnologien wie OData, IDoc oder BAPI.

title: UI Engineer (Based in CA or NC only)
description:
Mission: Live at the intersection of app runtime & security. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security.

The role

Location: Must be based in CA (preferably San Francisco Bay Area) or North Carolina

You will work alongside BlueRock's product designers and the control plane development team on our operator consoles. These are the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them.

The domain is AI and agentic systems, seen from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a person sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. So the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so someone can find the one that matters?) and control problems (how do you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down?).

This is a mid-level role. We expect about 3–5 years of professional front-end experience, or equivalent work that clearly shows the same judgment. The ideal candidate is passionate about user experience, design, and AI-assisted software development, with a demonstrated grounding in engineering best practices. The title says UI, but the work doesn’t stop there: you’ll work closely with our backend services, and a feature is finished when it’s proven working live, not when the screen looks right.

Working with design delivered as code

At BlueRock, product designers design and collaborate in code. Instead of handing off static mockups, they build working UI with AI coding tools, against real data, and open merge requests. Iteration happens so quickly that it has outpaced our capacity for robust engineering collaboration and review.

This role closes that gap. You will collaborate directly with product designers and backend developers to keep UI development fast, by bridging the gap between vibe code and high-quality, sustainable, well-tested code. Some days that means reviewing and hardening a designer's branch so it can merge. Other days it means building the shared components, tests and guardrails that make the next branch need less hardening.

Beyond reviewing and hardening code, you'll help shape how it gets made. Working with designers and the AI tools

title: Head of Operations (GPU Fleet)
description:
Your mission

Demand for sovereign European compute is not our constraint. Capacity is. As Head of Operations you own Lyceum's GPU fleet end to end: every GPU we own, lease or operate for partners, from the first conversation with a data center to the day a node goes live and every day it runs after that.

The job has two halves. Grow the fleet: turn new financing into live GPUs, fast. Run the fleet: keep everything we operate available, efficient and under contract. Your north star is GPUs under management. You report directly to the CEO and work closely with the CFO, CTO and engineering. Depending on experience, we hire this role at Head or VP level.

What You'll Do

  • Secure data center capacity across Europe: power, liquid cooling, space, connectivity and colocation leases

  • Own relationships with OEMs and suppliers for servers, networking and storage, and manage lead times so hardware arrives when we need it

  • Run every deployment as a programme, from logistics and installation to burn-in, acceptance and handover to engineering

  • Keep the financing side of deployments clean: schedules, drawdown milestones, asset records, insurance and lender reporting

  • Run the live fleet together with engineering: availability, incidents, RMAs, warranty, spares and remote hands

  • Own supply-side contracts, renewals and SLAs, and drive down cost per GPU-hour

  • Build the operations team and the operating rhythm that lets us scale deployments without scaling chaos

 

Your profile

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of bringing physical infrastructure online at scale, ideally data centers, GPU or HPC clusters, or comparable hardware-heavy environments

  • You have owned the whole picture, from capacity and suppliers to deployment and live operations, not one slice of it

  • Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking. You see the whole board, from site selection to unit economics

  • Enough technical depth to hold your own with engineers and vendors on power, cooling, networking and hardware

  • Strong programme management: you run complex projects with many parties against hard deadlines

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.

We do not partner with search firms.

 

About

We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build and improve the products and systems behind Lokalise. You'll work closely with Product, Design, other engineers, and stakeholders to identify and solve meaningful customer problems, improve existing experiences, and shape what we build next.

Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, uncover their pains and needs, define their own goals, and choose how to solve the problems that matter most. We're hiring across multiple domains, so you'll own a real piece of the product and see your impact firsthand.

We're building an AI-native engineering culture where engineers take ownership of problems, not just implementation. We expect you to question assumptions, challenge decisions, contribute to product direction, and find better ways to solve customer problems.

You'll use AI throughout the development process to move faster without compromising quality. Your responsibility doesn't end when code reaches production. You'll care about whether what we built actually works, delivers value, and solves the problem we set out to address.

 

You Will

  • Own problems end to end, from discovery and design to production and iteration. You take initiative instead of waiting to be told.
  • Build, test, and maintain featur

About the Role

We are looking for experienced engineers to join the EU Traffic team, based at Deliveroo, part of DoorDash, and help build the next generation of DoorDash's Traffic platform. title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
Über DRIVAR

DRIVAR ist eine der führenden Plattformen für Sport- und Luxuswagenvermietung mit dem Ziel, der weltweit führende Sharing-Marketplace für Sportwagen und Oldtimer zu werden. Vom Hauptsitz in Magdeburg aus gestaltet das Team die Mobilität der Zukunft und bringt Menschen außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse näher.

Als Chief Technology Officer übernimmst du die strategische und operative Verantwortung für unsere gesamte technische Infrastruktur und Produktentwicklung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem CEO und COO zusammen, um die Skalierung unserer Plattform in Europa und weltweit sicherzustellen.

Wir sind ein sehr kleines und effizientes Team, d.h.: Dein Fokus liegt vor allem auf schneller, agiler Umsetzung und Output, weniger auf Planung und Steuerung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der technologischen Führung eines wachstumsstarken Technologieunternehmens oder einer Online-Plattform

  • Fundierte Expertise in der Architektur moderner Webanwendungen und Internet-Marktplätze, sowohl im Bereich Backend als auch Frontend

  • Starkes strategisches Denken gepaart mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität zur direkten Umsetzung technischer Initiativen

  • Forciertes KI- und Automatisierungs-Mindset, um deinen Output zu vervielfachen

  • Tiefes Verständnis & praktische Anwendung von SEO/GEO-Skills

  • Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Führungskompetenz im Umgang mit interdisziplinären Teams

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Das bieten wir dir

Du bist Teils eines visionären Geschäftsmodells mit jeder Menge Wachstumspotenzial, geleitet von einem Führungsteam mit einzigartigem Mindset, welches dich auch persönlich voranbringt!

Du erhältst zudem die Möglichkeit, über Unternehmensanteile persönlich am Wachstum zu partizipieren!

Wir unterstützen deine Zusammenarbeit durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice und Remote-Arbeiten. Für deinen Arbeitsweg und die Verpflegung stehen dir kostenloses Parken, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks zur Verfügung. Du profitierst zudem von Gutscheinen, Ermäßigungen und Mitarbeiterrabatten. Deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung fördern wir durch gezielte berufliche Bildung und Mentoring. Ein Firmenlaptop wird dir gestellt, und bei einem Umzug unterstützen wir dich bei Bedarf bei der Relocation. Zudem erwarten dich zusätzliche Urlaubstage, und auch Haustiere sind bei uns erlaubt.

title: Career Coach (all genders)
description:
Jobbeschreibung

Als Career Coach begleitest Du unsere Lernenden auf dem entscheidendsten Abschnitt ihres Weges: dem Sprung in den neuen Job. Mit gezieltem Bewerbungscoaching, individueller Karriereberatung und einer klaren Portion Motivation machst Du aus Unsicherheit, Selbstvertrauen und Qualifikationen echte Jobangebote.

Unsere Kurse vermitteln unseren Teilnehmenden echte, marktfähige Kompetenzen. Du sorgst dafür, dass diese auch von der Außenwelt gesehen werden, indem Du ihnen hilfst, ihre neuen Fähigkeiten sichtbar zu machen, selbstbewusst zu kommunizieren und in überzeugende Bewerbungen zu verwandeln.

Dabei bist Du nicht allein: Der Coaching-Prozess ist strukturiert, die Qualität abgesichert, und Du arbeitest eng mit dem Career Coaching Lead zusammen. Dein Fokus: Teilnehmende begleiten, dass sie ihren Berufseinstieg mit Klarheit und Zuversicht angehen.

Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle

  • Leitung eigener Kurse und Workshops zu Bewerbungsstrategien, Interview Training, Motivation und beruflicher Neuorientierung

  • 1:1-Coaching zur Unterstützung bei Jobsuche, Interviewvorbereitung und der Erstellung persönlicher Kompetenzprofile

  • Unterstützung bei professionellen Bewerbungsunterlagen und der Entwicklung einer klaren beruflichen Positionierung

  • Förderung von Motivation und Teilnehmenden Bindung durch eine vertrauensvolle, positive Coaching-Atmosphäre

  • Auf- und Ausbau eines aktiven Firmen- und Alumni-Netzwerks zur Förderung von Austausch, Kooperation und erfolgreicher Vermittlung

  • Analyse und Weiterentwicklung interner Career-Success-Prozesse sowie Unterstützung des Client Operations & Career Coaching Lead bei strategischen Projekten

  • Dokumentation und Reporting von Vermittlungsquoten, Coaching-Aktivitäten und Feedback an den Career Coaching Lead

Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation in Pädagogik, Psychologie oder Coaching

  • Erfahrung in Karriereberatung, Bewerbungscoaching oder Lernbegleitung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools (z. B. MS Office, CRM-Systeme, Projektmanagement-Tools) sowie Routine in der Erstellung von Präsentationen für Trainings, Management und Kooperationspartner

title: Operations Lead
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

The Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

title: Product Designer
description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We are growing our product design team and looking for an experienced mobile designer to expand features on our Android and iOS apps. You will have the opportunity to make financial services more accessible and inclusive for millions of people through working with thoughtful product managers, researchers, and engineers!

In this role, you'll:

  • Create high quality designs, interactions, and prototypes to explore ideas in service of the best solution for the project (Wave uses Figma).
  • Craft user research plans and work directly with our user researchers to identify problems and validate solutions in user testing.
  • Contribute to Wave's design system and component library.
  • Talk to customers and find solutions to their problems by thinking critically from their perspective.
  • Communicate the reasoning behind your product decisions in review sessions and in conversation with PMs. 
  • Prototype visual and UX concepts and iterate towards the right solution (Wave uses Claude for mobile prototyping with Android apks).

Key details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our hiring hubs (US, UK, Spain, Kenya, Ghana, Canada) or in one of our operating markets in Africa, including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and Burkina Faso.
  • You'll travel to one of our key markets for a 1 week immersion trip with your immediate team (Wave covers all costs). Outside of this 1 week immersion, you'll also travel to a market country with our product design lead and PMs, for a total of travel 2x a year. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer, Geospatial Visual Localization
description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.

This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will develop new approaches to open problems alongside our researchers in 3D vision and machine learning, and publish your work at leading conferences. You will help build and train large models on large-scale multi-modal datasets, including our proprietary collection of 30 billion posed images and ship them into production, to be used by people and robots from all over the world.

Our team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and other handheld devices, 360 cameras, vehicles, and drones, as well as aerial and satellite imagery, LiDAR, and external geographic data. Your focus will be to improve accuracy and robustness across urban and rural locations, cameras, seasons, weather, and capture quality. The system must remain reliable with noisy GPS, in GPS-denied environments, and with outdated reference maps. Each pose estimate comes with an uncertainty that our customers rely on, and keeping it well calibrated across these conditions is part of the work.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.


Role Overview

As Influencer Marketing Manager, you will develop and run Hilo’s influencer marketing program across our key markets. You will find creators whose voices and audiences fit our brand, negotiate effective partnerships, and shape content that makes Hilo relevant and credible. The role combines brand and performance: you will use data to estimate the potential of each partnership before we invest, measure its results, and apply what you learn to future campaigns.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core Responsibilities

  • Identify, assess, and recruit creators across relevant platforms and markets.
  • Develop campaign concepts that balance Hilo’s brand goals with measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Forecast likely reach, engagement, traffic, and acquisition outcomes to guide creator selection and budgets.
  • Negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines, and content usage rights, including rights to use creator content in paid campaigns.
  • Manage partnerships end to end, from briefing and content review through publication and reporting.
  • Build and nurture long-term relationships with creators and brand ambassadors to drive sustained awareness, trust, and advocacy.
  • Collaborate with paid media teams to amplify high-performing creator content across paid social and other relevant channels.
  • Set clear goals, track brand and performance metrics, and compare results with initial estimates.
  • Use campaign data and audience insights to improve creator selection, content formats, and investment decisions.

Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. title: Talent Sourcer (gn) / Recruiter (gn) - 100% REMOTE
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Eine Führungskraft mit zehn Jahren Bauerfahrung schreibt keine Bewerbungen. Sie steht auf der Baustelle. Die meisten schicken ihr eine Nachricht und warten. Du fasst nach, greifst zum Telefon und holst sie ins Gespräch. Wenn das nach dir klingt, lies weiter.

JIRO ist eine Personalberatung für Bau und Infrastruktur mit Kunden in ganz Europa. Wir besetzen anspruchsvolle Führungspositionen, die lange offen bleiben. Für diese Suche bauen wir ein Sourcing-Team aus Leuten auf, denen Durchschnitt nicht reicht.

Arbeite, wann du willst. Wo du willst. So viel du willst.

Dein Job in vier Schritten

  • Finden. Auf den gängigen Portalen und in Netzwerken suchst du die Profile, die zu unseren Stellen passen. Zu jeder Stelle bekommst du ein Briefing.
  • Ansprechen. Du schreibst Nachrichten, die nach Mensch klingen, nicht nach Vorlage oder KI.
  • Dranbleiben. Bleibt die Antwort aus, hakst du nach. Zeigt jemand Interesse, greifst du zum Telefon. Du bleibst am Ball, bis aus einem Vielleicht ein Termin wird.
  • Termin legen. Das Erstgespräch buchst du direkt im Kalender deines Kollegen. Ab da übernimmt er.

Vertrieb, Kundentermine und CRM-Pflege gehören nicht zu deinem Job. Deine ganze Energie geht ins Sourcing.

Wann, wo und wie viel: Du entscheidest

Wann du willst. Early Bird oder Nachteule, deine Entscheidung. Uns interessiert, was du lieferst, nicht ob dein Teams-Status grün ist.

Wo du willst. Du arbeitest zu 100 % remote. Lust auf ein paar Wochen Dubai, Lissabon oder Catania? Workation ist bei uns gern gesehen. Einzige Regel: Telefoniert wird, wenn Europa wach ist.

So viel du willst. Wie viel du rausholst, entscheidest du selbst.

Dein Verdienst hat keinen Deckel

Deine Vergütung setzt sich aus vier Teilen zusammen:

  • eine feste Basis
  • eine Provision für jedes Gespräch, das du legst
  • eine Provision für jede Einstellung, die daraus entsteht
  • Extra-Boni, die wir spontan ausloben, etwa für geknackte Ziele oder brennende Stellen

Was du außerdem bekommst

  • Jeden Tag gemeinsam besser. Wir treffen uns täglich als Team. Was hat funktioniert, was nicht, was machen wir morgen anders? Wir wachsen zusammen, nicht jeder für sich.
  • Feedback, das dich weiterbringt. Wir sagen dir offen, was gut lief und wo noch Luft ist. Ehrlich, direkt, ohne Watte.
  • Stillstand gibt’s nicht. Suche, Ansprache, Nachfassen: Wir testen, messen und schärfen nach. Was besser funktioniert, wird Standard für dich und das ganze Team.
  • Aufstieg für alle, die Bock haben. Sourcing ist bei uns keine Sackgasse. Wer mehr will und das zeigt, wächst in die nächste Rolle.
  • Kleines Team, kurze Wege. Schnelle Ents

Kurz gesagt:
Du verbindest technisches Know-how mit Kommunikationsstärke – und gestaltest die digitale Zukunft der Kommunen aktiv mit.

Qualifikation
