title: Head of IT
description:
Unternehmen

Die PolymerCycle Gruppe ist ein integriertes Kunststoffrecycling-Unternehmen und vereint die Best Plastic Management GmbH, PB Solutions GmbH, ATP Service & Consulting GmbH und Hoffmann+Voss GmbH. Gemeinsam machen wir aus Kunststoffabfällen hochwertige Rezyklate, die Neuware in anspruchsvollen Anwendungen ersetzen – etwa in der Automobil-, Elektro- oder Verpackungsindustrie.

Dabei decken unsere Gesellschaften jeden Schritt des Recyclingkreislaufs ab: vom Handel mit Sekundärrohstoffen und PCR-/PIR-Stoffströmen über die Trennung komplexer Kunststoffgemische mit innovativen Dichtetrennverfahren und die Regranulierung in großen Mengen bis hin zu maßgeschneiderten Recompounds für technische Kunststoffe.

Damit zählt PolymerCycle zu den wenigen Anbietern, die den gesamten Recyclingkreislauf vom Kunststoffabfall bis zum fertig spezifizierten Compound aus einer Hand abbilden – und ist optimal aufgestellt für die wachsende europäische Nachfrage nach hochwertigen Rezyklaten.

Digitale Geschäftsprozesse verbinden bei uns alle Bereiche: vom Vertrieb über die Steuerung der Stoffströme und die Produktion bis zur kaufmännischen Abwicklung. Diese vernetzte Systemlandschaft wollen wir gezielt weiterentwickeln.

Als Head of IT (m/w/d) der PolymerCycle Gruppe verantwortest Du den zuverlässigen Betrieb dieser Systeme und bringst neue Technologien aktiv und pragmatisch ein, immer mit Blick auf den Nutzen für das Geschäft.

Position

Head of IT

Anstellung in der PolymerCycle Gruppe mit übergreifender Verantwortung für die IT aller Gesellschaften

Aufgaben & Verantwortung

  • Gesamtverantwortung für IT und Digitalisierung der Unternehmensgruppe mit klarem Fokus auf Standardisierung, Skalierbarkeit und Wertsteigerung im Private-Equity-Umfeld

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer gruppenweiten IT- und Digitalisierungsstrategie inklusive Roadmap, Budgetverantwortung und Priorisierung in enger Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung und Gesellschaftern

  • Harmonisierung und Weiterentwicklung der ERP- und Applikationslandschaft über alle Gesellschaften hinweg, inklusive der IT-seitigen Integration neu erworbener Unternehmen

  • Verantwortung für einen stabilen, sicheren und skalierbaren IT-Betrieb an allen Standorten – von Infrastruktur, Netzwerken und Cloud-Services bis hin zur Produktions-IT

  • Sicherstellung und Weiterentwicklung von IT-Security, Business Continuity und Compliance inklusive Richtlinien, Notfallkonzepten und Awareness in der Organisation

  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung der IT-Funktionen in den Gesellschaften sowie Steuerung externer Dienstleister und Partner inklusive Vertrags-, Kosten- und Leistungscontrolling

  • Zentrale Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen den Fachbereichen, den Gesellschaften, der Geschäftsführung und dem Private-Equity-Investor als Sparringspartner für Digitalisierungs- und Automatisierungsinitiativen<

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance & Beratung (unternehmerisch, leistungsbasiert)
description:
Du studierst und willst mehr als einen „Nebenjob“? Du willst Verantwortung, klare Ziele und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung zählt? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm.

Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Startphase (erste Wochen):

  • Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf.

  • Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards.

  • Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse.

Im weiteren Verlauf:

  • Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor.

  • Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte.

  • Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher.

  • Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards

  • Mentoring & Coaching: regelmäßiges Feedback, klare Ziele

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt)

  • Skalierbare Perspektive: Option auf Übernahme ins Trainee-Programm

  • Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr”

  • Team mit Performanc

title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
description:
Über DrAnsay

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.

Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst

  • Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

  • OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

  • Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

  • Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

title: Global Account Manager - Automotive
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

You’ll grow a portfolio of our most important automotive OEM and supplier accounts in EMEA, working hand in hand with our Business Development leaders. Our deals are large, technical and multi-year. These deals are built on a foundation of understanding multiple technical and business stakeholders, from individual engineers, to leadership and C-suite. You will need to spend time understanding what an engineering team is battling, what the program manager is worried about, how to gain support and buy in from procurement and purchasing teams, and what the CTO is trying to achieve at a strategic level, then pull these threads together to build a successful deal. You'll work hand in hand with solution engineering and business development teams to shape, build and close deals. Internally, you’ll coordinate engineering, product, legal and finance to deliver on what we commit.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Own critical client relationships and expand reach into key accounts including major OEM and Tier 1 relationships.

  • Drive strategic alignment and executive engagement across R&D, procurement and other relevant teams

  • Grow current footprint across Applied Intuition's solutions and land multi year commercial deals, including securing r

title: Senior Solutions Architect (German speaking)
description:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like PUMA, Carhartt WIP, Anthropic, Just Eat Takeaway, Spotify, HiPP, and Mercedes-AMG are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

Your team ensures that enterprise customers are successful and happy using Sanity. This means working closely with technical leaders at our customers to align their strategic goals with implementation details; facilitating brainstorming sessions between editors, designers, and developers; and helping developers make decisions for their unique business needs.

In this role, you will take ownership of your customer relationships and drive both internal and external conversations. You'll also have the opportunity to learn more and develop expertise on the people's side of technology.

What you would do:

  • Lead onboarding workshops that are customized to each customer’s needs and background.

  • Proactively develop relationships with technical and product stakeholders at our customers.

  • Meet regularly with technical customers to demonstrate how new features work for the customer’s specific needs, answer their questions, and help them plan their Sanity implementation.

  • Work with account managers to develop expansion opportunities at existing customers

  • Support the new account sales cycle through technical workshops and proof of concept development

  • Create and share examples to help customers understand concepts and implement more quickly

  • Develop and maintain guides and learning modules to address common topics

  • Develop and maintain plugins for common integrations and implementation patterns

  • Represent clients’ requests and requirements to the internal product team

  • Work with Support Engineering to work through customer challenges and unblock specific scenarios

  • Support marketing and product research teams to connect with relevant customers and plan events and webinars

Hier übernehmen Sie die eigenständige Gesamtverantwortung für strategisch bedeutende Microsoft-Großprojekte. Mit Ihrer Erfahrung, ausgeprägten Führungskompetenz und einem souveränen Blick für das Wesentliche steuern Sie komplexe Vorhaben selbstbestimmt und konsequent zum Erfolg.

Sie übernehmen, wenn andere nicht mehr weiterwissen im Microsoft Ökosystem.

In dieser Rolle tragen Sie Verantwortung für strategisch wichtige Microsoft-Initiativen wie Azure-Migrationen, M365-Rollouts, Dynamics-Implementierungen oder hybride Cloud-Architekturen – genau dann, wenn sie ins Stocken geraten.

Als erfahrener Project Manager mit technischem Microsoft-Fokus analysieren Sie die Ursachen, führen souverän durch Eskalationen, kennen sich im Vertragswesen aus, kommunizieren auf C-Level und setzen gezielte Maßnahmen zur Stabilisierung und Neuausrichtung um.

Dabei steuern Sie komplexe Softwareentwicklungs- und Integrationsprojekte im Millionenbereich mit hoher technologischer Tiefe – und sorgen dafür, dass Microsoft-Lösungen genau das liefern, was sie versprechen: echte Wirkung, nachhaltige Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit.

Qualifikation

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Langjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Microsoft-Projekte

  • Führungserfahrung in größeren, interdisziplinären Teams (25+ Personen)

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in klassischen und agilen Projektmethoden (z. B. PMI, PRINCE2, Scrum) sowie im Vertrags- und Eskalationsmanagement

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, sicheres Auftreten, Durchsetzungsvermögen und Reisebereitschaft

Benefits

  • Maximale Eigenverantwortung: Sie arbeiten autark – mit viel Freiraum für eigene Entscheidungen

  • Hohe Flexibilität: Ihr Arbeitsplatz? Deutschlandweit – remote oder vor Ort

  • Fokussiertes Umfeld: Ein kleines, hochspezialisiertes Team mit direkter Anbindung an strategische Entscheider

  • Geld, das Leistung abbildet: 50–60k Fix, 5–20 % Provision ab dem ersten Euro, 100k+ OTE für alle, die liefern.

Position summary

Prosci Executive Instructors are dynamic teachers and facilitators, with a passion for change management and our client’s success. With deep business expertise, and a thorough understanding of Prosci’s change management research, methodologies, and tools, you will not only deliver a variety of programs designed to build the client's change management capabilities, but you will also help to establish Prosci as a valuable, long-term partner to organizations as they navigate their most critical change initiatives.  

Scope & Responsibilities 

Deliver a variety of programs on Prosci change methodology, tools, and research:

  • Instruct clients in Prosci’s proprietary change management methodology virtually, or at client locations or Prosci-selected venues across the Europe and EMEA 
  • Maintain up-to-date mastery of Prosci’s change management offerings
  • Combine career experience with Prosci methodology to illustrate real-world change management application and answer clients’ questions specific to their individual change initiatives
  • Prepare thoughtfully for sessions to provide incredible learning experiences for all participants
  • Serve our client relationships to establish Prosci as a valuable, long-term partner to organizations as they navigate their most critical change initiatives

Driving and Influencing Change: 

  • Foster a culture of adaptability and resilience within colleagues, customers, and program participants
  • Drive digital transformation by engaging in new technologies and processes to improve efficiency and competitiveness
  • Operates as a recognized expert to orient work in a workflow to plan, organize, and execute the steps it takes to achieve a goal to achieve higher efficiency. Typically known as a subject matter authority
  • Applies expertise to act as an authority to quickly identify and accurately articulate why a client does or does not want a change based on their business objectives and challenges

 

Managing Critical Relationships 

  • Develop a thorough understanding of the customers specific needs, objectives and challenges related to organizational change initiatives.  Actively listen and ask pertinent questions to uncover potential barriers or resistance factors
  • Offer expert advice, guidance and recommendations to clients based on your in-depth knowledge and experiences with Prosci tools and methodologies
  • Understand complex topics and processes required to mentor clients in applying Prosci methodologies within their environment
  • Actively seek feedback from colleagues and customers to identify areas for improvement and enhance the client experience

title: CRO Manager
description:
Über diese Rolle

Du liebst es, den Engpass im Funnel zu finden und $100 Million Offers zu bauen?

Als CRO Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Performance unseres Onlineshops vom ersten Klick auf die Ad bis zum letzten Upsell. Du analysierst den Funnel von A bis Z, findest den Engpass und löst ihn mit besseren Offers, Funnels und Tests.

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral Cloud builds and operates the infrastructure that powers Mistral's AI. The Data Centers team signs long-term leases for data center capacity developed by third-party operators, sources the GPUs that fill those halls, and runs the workloads that train and serve Mistral's models. Today the team is around 40 people, mainly based in Paris with some remote members, and operates roughly 200 MW of existing capacity across France. Key partners include Éclairion in France and EcoDC in Sweden, which is currently delivering Mistral's first Swedish data center.

The team sits at the center of an ambitious roadmap: Mistral has publicly committed to securing one gigawatt of data center capacity globally by 2030. With 200 MW already online, roughly 800 MW remain to be secured over the next five years.

The Role

This hire acquires the data center capacity that Mistral's next generation of models will run on. Across Europe, you will negotiate co-location agreements and built-to-suit contracts with data center developers, structure master services agreements and order forms, and make sourcing decisions grounded in a deep understanding of what the capacity will actually be used for: training frontier LLMs, serving inference at scale, or both.

The role sits at the intersection of commercial negotiation and technical infrastructure. You will need to translate workload requirements into contract terms, assess whether a given site can deliver the power, cooling, and connectivity Mistral needs, and close deals that lock in capacity years before the GPUs arrive.

What You Will Do

  • Negotiate master services agreements, order forms, and co-location or built-to-suit contracts with data center developers across Europe

  • Structure capacity sourcing decisions based on workload requirements: training, inference, or hybrid

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Freelance French SEO Content Writer to strengthen our organic search visibility and AI

search presence across the French markets, including France and French-speaking Africa.

Our current French organic search visibility presents a significant growth opportunity. We are looking for a writer who can

create original, high-quality French content tailored to local audiences, search intent, and SEO best practices. This is a

content-writing role, not a translation role.

The successful candidate will help improve our visibility across traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered

answer engines, including ChatGPT and similar platforms.

Key Responsibilities

• Create high-quality French content pieces, based on briefs and keyword targets provided by the SEO team.

• Develop original, engaging and SEO-optimised content for French-speaking audiences in France and Africa.

• Write content aligned with target keywords, search intent, content structure, and on-page SEO requirements.

• Optimise content for traditional search engines as well as AI-powered search and answer engines.

• Research relevant topics, industry trends, competitors, and audience needs to develop authoritative content.

• Adapt and localise existing English-language content for French-speaking markets while ensuring the content reads

naturally and is culturally relevant.

• Incorporate feedback from internal stakeholders and make revisions as required.

• Maintain consistency in brand voice, messaging, content quality, and SEO guidelines.

Types of Content

• Commercial landing pages

• Blogs and thought-leadership articles

• Glossary and definition pages

• Whitepapers and long-form content

• Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

• Localised versions of existing English-language articles

• Native French writing proficiency, with an excellent command of French grammar, vocabulary, and writing

title: Compliance Director
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

Und das nicht für irgendwelche Shops, sondern für Marken, die du wirklich kennst: mymuesli, Pammys, zeroLabs, Supernaturals, FAVLY und viele mehr.

Aufgaben

Hast du Bock auf verstaubte Asana-Boards, chaotische Excel-Listen und endlose Calls, nach denen keiner weiß, wer was macht?

Wir auch nicht.

Was du stattdessen machst:

  • Du behältst alle Projekte im Blick, briefst unser Design-Team und sorgst dafür, dass jede Mail pünktlich rausgeht.

  • Du schreibst Copy, die trifft und verkauft.

Fähigkeiten & Erfahrung

  • Du hast bereits Copywriting-Erfahrung und schreibst Texte, die verkaufen.

Einstellung & Herangehensweise

  • Du übernimmst 100% Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse.

description:

title: Compliance Director
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

title: Senior Project Manager, UK
description:
Job Description: Sr. Project Manager, UK

 

Location: Remote, UK Only

 

About The Company:

MustardSeed PMO designs and delivers project management solutions for complex, regulated sectors. We build PMOs, plan, staff, and run projects and programs, and provide seasoned project managers on demand.

 

We’re known for fast, structured onboarding that plugs in quickly and builds momentum. Our frameworks improve communication, control, and execution to drive better decisions and measurable results.

 

We support clients across life sciences, aerospace, food, tech, and financial services aligning PM discipline to each organization’s stage.

 

About the Role:

As a Sr. Project Manager at MustardSeed, you will be contributing to end-to-end project delivery within specified timeframes, budgets, and quality standards. As an experienced project manager already, you will collaborate closely with stakeholders to ensure the best possible outcomes, steering multidisciplinary teams towards common goals.

 

The Sr. Project Manager is the chief “make sure it happens – and happens right” person on the project and has the overall responsibility for ensuring that the outputs from each project phase – the initiation, planning, execution and closing phases – are delivered according to the requirements established and approved for that phase, and that these outputs are consistent across all phases.

 

You will contribute to a wide variety of different projects while maintaining a focus on project management best practices and stakeholder satisfaction.

 

Previous projects our team has facilitated include but are not limited to creating a robust integrated master schedule (IMS) for an upcoming clinical trial, identifying, and eliminating bottlenecks in a new product introduction (NPI) process, completing a transformative overhaul of a client’s product lifecycle management (PLM) process, ensuring the successful delivery of a newly acquired software, overhauling a client’s supply chain management (SCM) practices.

title: Radiologist - Chest CT Annotation - AI Project (UK)
description:
We are seeking radiologists with a chest/thoracic background to carry out structural annotation on de-identified chest CT scans, with a focus on spatial accuracy and consistency against detailed annotation guidelines.

You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, marking points, boxes and measurements on findings that have already been flagged upstream, to support the development of clinical AI imaging models.

This is a remote, flexible and short-term project.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Click-point placement: Mark specific coordinates on a scan, such as the centre of a nodule.

  • Bounding boxes: Draw boxes around defined regions of interest, such as a flagged lesion.

  • Simple measurements: Record diameter, or distance between two marked points, on segmentations or polygons already drawn.

  • Guideline application: Work to an annotation guideline covering placement conventions, boundary definitions and measurement rules, applied consistently across a large volume of studies.

  • Edge case handling: Flag ambiguous cases with a short rationale so guidance can be refined.

This is structural markup project with no interpretation required. You will not be reading scans for diagnosis, judging malignancy, or making clinical decisions.


Qualifications:

  • Registration: Registered radiologist in your country of practice with active license

  • Experience: 3–10 years' experience in radiology, with a chest/thoracic focus

title: ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops)
description:
StellDirVor is an independent consulting, trade and technology company specializing in immersive technologies for healthcare. We support organizations in implementing digital innovations — Virtual, Augmented and Mixed Reality as well as AI — particularly for learning, training and real-time assistance in clinical and care environments. By combining technology and healthcare, we help optimize processes, improve knowledge transfer and enhance quality of care.

Supported by a Germany (ZIM) and Taiwanese (GIPIP) partnership grant, we are currently developing ARAIAS — an AR- and AI-based hands-free training and assistance system for chronic wound care. Using AR smart glasses, the system enables 3D capture, AI-supported analysis, and standardized remote expertise and documentation directly at the point of care.

As our ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops), you will build the AI capabilities at the core of ARAIAS: evaluating and fine-tuning computer vision models on smart glasses data, running the ML operations behind them, and applying generative AI to create synthetic medical images for education. We're at an early stage — moving from concept to working prototype — so the near-term focus is on validating models and building toward a proof of concept we can test in real education and clinical settings.

As part of a small team, you will own the full data lifecycle end to end — from sourcing, consent and annotation to preparation — alongside model development and deployment.

We welcome candidates at different experience levels. What matters most is a solid ML foundation and genuine awareness of the medical imaging domain.

Notes:

Due to the nature of the project, we can only consider candidates who are already residing in Germany.

Tasks

  • Select and benchmark pre-trained models and/or validated architectures for medical image analysis and adapt them to domain-specific data, ensuring robust performance under real-world conditions

  • Identify and adapt suitable generative AI models to create realistic synthetic medical images for education and training

  • Evaluate and fine-tune small language models (SLMs) for voice interaction — speech-to-text, intent understanding and text-to-speech — optimized for low-latency or on-device use with smart glasses

  • Research and assess state-of-the-art ML models and emerging trends, including Explainable AI (XAI), cybersecurity for ML, and deployment and distribution modes (edge vs. cloud, federated learning, model compression)

  • Plan and execute the ML operations pipeline — data gathering, annotation, preparation, training, testing and deployment

title: Partnerships Manager (South East)
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

Finding effective ways of generating new business is critical to our continued growth. One way is through partnerships with third-parties who refer their SME clients to Allica on an ongoing basis based on mutual trust. Our Partnerships Team work with trusted advisors to established SMEs, in particular their Accountants.

As a Partnerships Manager, you will develop and nurture relationships with accounting firms across your region, taking a consultative, B2B sales approach. You’ll own the end-to-end client experience for Business Rewards Account clients - from generating introductions through to onboarding and funding and coordinate with our specialist Relationship Manager team on additional lending needs. The role involves regional travel, in-person meetings and you’ll be supported by our Marketing team in running events.

• Grow Allica’s presence across each firm, including multiple stakeholders, colleagues and offices, through regular regional travel and in-person meetings.

Resilience Care is a leading provider of remote patient monitoring and a clinical research partner. Founded in France in 2021, our mission is to improve care.

We provide remote patient monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, combining electronic patient-reported outcomes (ePROs) with AI techniques. Tweag is a software consultancy that helps engineering organizations overcome technical bottlenecks that stand in the way of success. Our work in scalable build systems, primarily through Bazel, helps our clients grow their tech organization without the maintenance burden.

About you

Tweag works with organizations at all experience levels, from trying out Bazel for the first time, to refactoring and scaling Bazel workspaces with hundreds of thousands of potential targets. In every situation, we are the experts, helping them achieve their goals and delighting them with improvements they never expected.

We are looking for someone who can handle:

  • Integration with as-yet-unsupported languages.
  • Development of specialized Bazel toolchains.
  • Improving open-source Bazel rules to unblock our clients.
  • Using Gazelle to standardize and clean up code.
  • Refactoring Bazel code, and teaching others how to do so.
  • Debugging the internals of Bazel.

In addition, we'd appreciate

  • Ties to the Bazel community.
  • Active maintenance of Bazel open-source tools.
  • Expertise in Bazel performance optimization, both within rules and in evaluating the build graph.
  • Knowledge of other reproducible build systems, such as Nix, Buck2, or Pants.

You'll love Tweag if you love

  • A fully remote workplace with strong respect for work-life balance.
  • Working on complex engineering problems, often with no right answer.
  • A research-informed culture, with plenty of nerding out about computer science and mathematics.
  • Giving back to the community by contributing to open-source software, contributing to our blog, participating in working groups, and stewarding conferences.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer – SAP (m/f/d)
description:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.


The role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are Qorelo’s technical face at the customer. You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Then you bring what you learned back to our engineers.

You work directly with our engineering team and solution architects, report to Marino, our CTO, and spend a real share of your time with customers, both on site and remotely.

What you will own

  • SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations. You make the connection work and explain it to Basis and security teams in their language.

  • Workshops and demos on real environments. You run on-site workshops of several hours and show Qorelo on the customer’s own SAP landscape, not a sandbox: their custom code, their processes, their data. You prepare together with sales and our solution architects, and you handle the technical questions in the room.

  • Integrations. You connect the customer’s tools to Qorelo through our existing integrations across the SAP, Atlassian, Microsoft and similar ecosystems, and make sure they work on the customer’s landscape.

title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) Microsoft 365, Teilzeit oder Vollzeit
description:
Über Kigen IT-Systemhaus
Kigen IT-Systemhaus ist ein auf Microsoft 365 und IT-Sicherheit spezialisiertes Unternehmen mit Standorten in Engstingen und Stuttgart. Wir betreuen Unternehmen von der Kanzlei bis zur Unternehmensgruppe und legen Wert auf saubere, sichere IT-Umgebungen. Bei uns gibt es kurze Wege, Vertrauen und echte Weiterentwicklung statt Konzernstrukturen.

Deine Aufgaben
Du bist fester technischer Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden im Raum Stuttgart. Du bearbeitest Support-Anfragen im First und Second Level, richtest Arbeitsplätze, Drucker und Besprechungsräume ein und bist bei Bedarf auch vor Ort beim Kunden. Im laufenden Betrieb verwaltest du Benutzer, Geräte und Lizenzen in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online und Teams und unterstützt in hybriden Umgebungen mit Active Directory.

Das bringst du mit
Du hast eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung und bereits im IT-Support oder in der Administration gearbeitet. Windows Clients und Active Directory sind dir vertraut, Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 und Intune ist ein Plus. Du hast einen Führerschein und gehst ruhig und freundlich mit Kunden um. Du erfüllst nicht alles? Wenn du motiviert bist, dich einzuarbeiten, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Deine ersten Monate
Du lernst unsere Kunden und deren Umgebungen kennen, übernimmst Schritt für Schritt den Support und arbeitest dabei eng mit dem Gründer zusammen. So bekommst du direkten Wissenstransfer, auch in Themen wie Security und Compliance.

Was wir bieten

  • Teilzeit (ab 20 Stunden) oder Vollzeit, ganz wie es zu dir passt

  • Remote-Arbeit, vor Ort nur bei Kundenterminen im Raum Stuttgart

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und moderne Ausstattung

  • Echte Lernkurve in Microsoft 365 und IT-Sicherheit

Vergütung
45.000 bis 55.000 € brutto jährlich bei Vollzeit, je nach Erfahrung. Bei Teilzeit anteilig.

title: Machine Learning Researcher
description:
Company

Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI.

We develop ultra-low-latency voice models that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure.

By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we're making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure.

Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and has raised significant funding from leading European investors. We work with global enterprises across hardware and consumer AI that are building the next generation of voice-enabled products. Our open source models have been downloaded over 4 million times and earned over 6,500 GitHub stars since launch.

Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone.

Please review our Hugging Face and GitHub repos before applying, as they’ll be part of the interview discussion.


Role

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to help advance the state of the art in speech synthesis.

You will work on research and development across the full speech pipeline — from model architecture and training to dataset design and production deployment. The role combines applied research with real-world engineering, working closely with a small team pushing the boundaries of real-time speech systems.

We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in text-to-speech systems, or multimodal machine learning involving speech and audio.

Your work will include:

  • Researching and developing state-of-the-art speech synthesis models

  • Training and optimising models for high-quality, low-latency speech generation

  • Building and curating high-quality proprietary speech datasets

  • Improving model quality, expressiveness, and latency

  • Working closely with engineers to bring research models into production syste

title: Langfuse - DevRel Engineer, Events & Community (EMEA)
description:
Location and travel

You can be based in Europe; we're mainly remote and invite you to the Berlin office 3-5 days every two months.

We expect significant travel across the Europe, with occasional travel to other regions when the audience quality justifies it. The exact cadence will change with the event calendar, but you should expect travel to be a meaningful part of the job.

 

Why this role?

Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.

However, many of the highest-signal moments happen in person: hallway conversations, workshops, meetups, dinners, conference demos, and technical talks.

We want someone who can own that motion end to end; put Langfuse in the right AI engineering rooms, make the product clear to technical audiences, and turn in-person conversations into durable marketing momentum.

The goal is not to do every event. The goal is to make the right events excellent, scalable, and measurable.

 

What you'll do

  • Represent Langfuse at conferences, meetups, workshops, customer events, partner events, and community gatherings across Europe

  • Run live demos and technical sessions on tracing, evals, prompt management, datasets, metrics, and related LLM engineering workflows.

  • Build and maintain field-ready material: demo flows, workshop runbooks, talk abstracts, event landing pages, follow-up emails, signup flows, and conference-in-a-box assets.

  • Organize Langfuse-hosted meetups, workshops, dinners, and smaller technical gatherings around the highest-quality audiences.

  • Partner with ClickHouse field marketing, sales, solutions, product marketing, and engineering teams where it helps Langfuse show up well.

  • Turn event learnings into useful artifacts: better messaging, better demos, better docs, better talks, better customer stories, and sharper product feedback.

 

What we're looking for

  • You have worked in DevRel, product marketing engineering, solutions engineering, field engineering, developer advocacy, or technical community roles.

title: Principal Database Performance Engineer - Core Engineering (C++)

ClickHouse — Core Analytics Database

description:
Role: Senior Design Engineer

Company: Deel

Location: United Kingdom, Israel, Portugal, Spain, Czech Republic, Poland, France, Switzerland, Hungary, Ireland, Sweden, Germany or Estonia

Job Type: Full-time

About Deel

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance and equipment management sit in one product. It supports every worker type in 150+ countries. In 2024, Deel paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits in 109 countries.

The company has a $17.3 billion valuation and reached $1 billion in ARR in just over five years. About 7,000 people work at Deel, across more than 100 countries and 74 languages. Customers rate it 4.83 on average, from 15,000 reviews on G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, Apple and Google.

Most teams use AI as a faster way for humans to build products. Deel wants to go further and build the system that lets AI build the products. Humans set the taste, the guardrails and the standards it works within.

That system is your product. You build what AI generates against: the design system and component architecture, the generation and agent workflows, the quality gates that keep output production-ready, and the feedback loops that keep it all visible to the team. You stay hands-on as a designer, because the quickest way to prove the system works is to ship real interfaces on top of it.

This is a senior individual contributor role in Product Design. You split your time between Figma and a code editor in roughly equal measure. You work directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you sit in a cross-functional team with Engineering and Product.

What you are expected to do:

Build the system

  • Architect the design system, tokens and components as the substrate AI generates against.

  • Design prompt libraries, patterns and agent workflows that turn design intent into production-ready UI with minimal human assembly.

Prove it by designing

  • Stay a practising designer. Explore concepts quickly and design real interfaces.

  • Prototype in production front-end code. You are the first and toughest test of whether the system produces excellent, shippable work.

title: AIT MGSE Engineer - Lunar Lander

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

title: Chief of Staff Intern
description:
What is Finary?

Money is broken. Most people's wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see, and a private banker costs more than they will ever pay. We are putting one in everyone's pocket: the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client.

Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us, for free. Finary AI turns that financial context into a plan, and our own investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real: clarity on what you have, guidance on where you are going, action to get there.

Why now?

AI makes this vision possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy:

  • Data: years of per-user financial history, goals and risk profiles that no public dataset holds.

  • Brand: half of our new users come from our own channels, and 1 signup in 5 names our YouTube channel.

  • Licences: stocks, ETFs and crypto on one regulated platform, passportable across Europe. We started early, when a simple registration was enough: PSAN in 2022, Investment Firm licence in March 2026, MiCA in July 2026. Since July, every crypto platform in Europe must be licensed or stop.

Many fintechs will have the AI, and a few will have the licences. We have all 3. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest, alongside founders and operators like Steve Anavi & Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (former UBS Chairman) and Harsh Sinha (CTO at Wise). There's never been a more exciting time to join.

What we offer

We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to.

We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day.

Read more about our values

Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse, impliquée, débarrassée des tabous autour de l'argent. Nous sommes 70 builders qui aimons profondément ce que nous faisons : de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour, un package salaire et equity au meilleur niveau du marché, des bureaux en plein cœur de Paris avec du remote hybride, et des offsites trimestriels qu'on attend vraiment.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
We’re EngagedMD, a Patient Journey Management solution for specialty care that helps practices improve patient experience, reduce administrative burden, and convert more patients to care, faster.

We’re looking for a Senior Financial Analyst who can translate financial data into meaningful insights that support business decisions. In this role, you’ll take ownership of key financial processes, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis, helping us better understand business performance and plan for continued growth. You’ll collaborate with teams across the organization to identify trends, improve financial visibility, and support our evolving business needs. As part of a small, growing company, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by strengthening our financial operations and helping shape how we plan for the future.

This fully remote role reports to our Chief of Staff, and candidates are required to reside in the United States. This role requires legal authorization to work in the United States. EngagedMD is unable to sponsor current H1B visa holders for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Own the annual budgeting process, including budget development and planning.

  • Manage quarterly financial forecasts, incorporating business performance and updated financial projections.

  • Conduct monthly and quarterly budget-to-actual variance analysis, identifying key trends, discrepancies, and drivers of financial performance.

  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis to provide insights and support strategic and operational decision-making.

  • Assist with month-end accounting activities, including reviewing financial results and supporting accurate financial reporting, including limited journal entry posting.

  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting efficiency, and the overall quality of financial insights provided to the business.

What You'll Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in corporate finance, banking, Big Four accounting, or a related financial analysis or accounting role with a desire to transition to a finance oriented role.

  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, including advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to query and analyze financial data.

title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager (m/w/d), Vollzeit und Teilzeit
description:
Über Joberg

Senior SEO & GEO Manager (m/w/d) – mit Option auf Head of SEO & GEO – OTE 130.000 € – Vollzeit – Remote, hybrid oder vor Ort in München oder Wien

Die meisten SEO-Stellen suchen jemanden, der Tickets abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der uns sagt, welche Tickets es überhaupt geben sollte.

Über uns

Wir bauen gerade eine zweite Business Unit auf: GEO-SEO für ausgewählte Nischen, die die großen Agenturen nicht beachten. Gemeint ist Sichtbarkeit dort, wo Menschen heute fragen, also bei Google und in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini. Die Nachfrage haben wir in den ersten Verkaufsgesprächen bereits bestätigt.

Dahinter steht Joberg, eine „kleine“, aber feine Marketing-Agentur. Unser erstes Standbein sind Paket-Mailings, mit denen unsere Kund:innen auf dem Schreibtisch von Entscheider:innen landen. Mit der neuen Unit expandieren wir in den SEO/GEO- und vielleicht in Zukunft in den SEA/GEA-Markt. Was dafür noch fehlt, bist du.

Bei uns gibt es flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und keine Büropolitik. Wir arbeiten konzentriert, haben dabei Spaß und nehmen uns selbst nicht zu ernst. Wir finden, dass ein Job, der Spaß macht, und ein richtig gutes Gehalt sich nicht ausschließen.

Ehrlich gesagt

Es gibt noch keinen Prozess, kein Team und kein Handbuch. Das ist kein Mangel, das ist der Job. Du bist Person Nummer eins in diesem Bereich und trägst 100 % der Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. Den Plan schreibst du. Und wenn du findest, dass wir falsch liegen, sag es. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Perspektive

Du startest als Senior SEO & GEO Manager und setzt selbst um. Wenn der Bereich wächst, hast du die Option, dich zum Head of SEO & GEO zu entwickeln und ein eigenes Team aufzubauen. Wie und wann, gestalten wir gemeinsam.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du setzt SEO, GEO und Bewertungsmanagement für unsere Kund:innen um, von der Analyse bis zum Ergebnis.

  • Du findest heraus, was ein Unternehmen in KI-Antworten nach vorne bringt, und machst daraus eine wiederholbare Methode (Framework/SOP).

  • Du baust das Fulfillment und die automatisierten Workflows mit KI so auf, dass sie mit jedem neuen Kunden besser werden und nicht langsamer.

  • Du sagst uns, welche Nischen sich deiner Meinung nach lohnen und welche nicht.

Was du kannst

title: Product Manager, Agent Platform
description:
Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

title: Enterprise Demand Generation Marketing Manager
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

  • Plan, launch and optimize paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and content syndication channels, owning budget pacing, testing and reporting on CAC, pipeline and ROI

  • Use paid and organic social to reach buyers, amplify campaigns and generate demand, working closely with Content

title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in France.

As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems.
You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures.
Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.
Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents.
You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks.
Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization.
This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities.

  • Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems.

  • Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes.

  • Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking.

  • Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements.

  • Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment.

  • Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback.

· Experience with two-tier/channel sales ecosystem required

· History of sales experience with partner accounts

· History of consistent plan development and quota achievement

· Strong presentation and written skills

· Ability to self-manage and work remotely

· Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM


Experience

title: Senior M&A Finance Integration Manager

  • Proven experience leading M&A finance integrations, divestitures or carve-outs, including Day 1 readiness and post-merger integration

  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP Central Finance, SAP Group Reporting or comparable ERP and financial consolidation systems

title: Product Manager - Preclinical Device
description:
Location: London, with occasional travel.

 

About Netholabs

Netholabs builds large-scale neural and behavioural recording platforms to generate the data needed for the next generation of brain models. We operate two recording platforms: a preclinical ethological monitoring system integrated with behaviour and neural data and a human motion-capture and neurophysiology platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where hardware, neuroscience, and ML sit in the same room.

 

The Role

We are building integrated human motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems for both controlled lab studies and naturalistic, in-the-wild data collection. Today we have working prototypes. We need someone to turn them into products - reproducible, manufacturable, remotely updatable systems that can be deployed at scale and maintained without an engineer in the room.

You will own R&D delivery across the London lab and hardware programme: co-developing the hardware with our electronics and mechanical engineers, importing and enforcing best-practice data capture protocols, and engaging contract manufacturers to scale. This is an agentic, hands-on role -with support engineer roles as required. You will spend as much time in the lab and on the phone with suppliers as you will in a spec document.

 

What you'll do

  • Take working prototypes to shippable, field-deployable systems — define the product, own the roadmap, and drive it to delivery

  • Specify and build out over-the-air update infrastructure: firmware, versioning, rollback, fleet management, remote diagnostics

  • Own the design-for-manufacture transition — DFM/DFA reviews, BOM ownership, tolerancing, test fixtures, and production test protocols

  • Identify, qualify, and manage contract manufacturers and suppliers; own the relationship from RFQ through NPI to sustained production

  • Establish and enforce best-practice data capture protocols across modalities (EEG, fNIRS, EMG, pupillometry, motion capture, video) so that data quality is consistent across sessions, operators, and sites

  • Define the requirements that make in-the-wild collection viable: wearability, session setup time, robustness, battery life, and unattended operation

  • Work directly with our electronics, mechanical, firmware, and neuroscience teams to translate research needs into hardware requirement

· Translate organisational quality objectives into practical engineering standards.

· Demonstrate practical integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
Über YLAB

Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden.

Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene.

Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten.

Warum YLAB

Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.

Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt.

Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch.

Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden.

Was wir bieten

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

  • Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst.

  • Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt.

  • Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln.

Über die Rolle

Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo: ein kleiner, bildschirmfreier KI-Freund, der Kindern zwischen 4 und 9 ihre Warum-Fragen beantwortet. Der Prototyp funktioniert, der Launch ist 2027. Jetzt brauchen wir jemanden, der Onoo in die Köpfe und Wohnzimmer von Eltern bringt.

Du bist unsere erste Marketing-Person, mit Platz am Gründertisch. Keine Agentur, kein Team unter dir, keine fertigen Prozesse. Du baust Marke, Community und Funnel von null auf – erst mit den eigenen Händen, dann mit einem Team.

Was dich erwartet: ein Hardware-Produkt plus Abo, Direktvertrieb in DACH und Eltern als Zielgruppe, die das Beste für ihre Kinder wollen und Datenschutz ernst nehmen. Und ein Thema, bei dem KI und Kinder in einem Satz stehen. Da gewinnt, wer Vertrauen aufbauen kann.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

  • Du machst aus Onoo eine Marke, die Eltern sofort verstehen: Positionierung, Story, Ton – vom Video bis zum Karton.

  • Du baust unsere UGC-Maschine: Creator finden, briefen, Hooks schreiben, jede Woche 10–20 Ad-Varianten testen, lernen, wiederholen.

  • Du bringst 5.000 Familien auf die Warteliste, bevor es Onoo zu kaufen gibt – und hältst sie bei Laune (Newsletter, Social, „Kinderfrage des Tages“).

About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

    • What you'll bring
  • You've worked in telecom QA, network testing, service assurance or roaming validation.
  • You know how LTE/EPC fits together. Give you a registration or session flow and you'll find where it broke.
  • Wireshark is where you go first, not last.

    • Experimental design, reference-data limitations, and quantitative performance assessment.
    • Building reproducible engineering tools and communicating technical evidence to mission teams.
